The expected JSON is GeoSonnar's independent raw-field transcription, checked
against the provider's separate simple-feature response. It is not a location
validation case. All36 positions/times and144 source parameter values matched.
Timestamp representation is whole seconds, coordinate datum is ETRS89, and
ellipse_major units/confidence semantics remain unresolved. No altitude is
inferred. Rows may share a timestamp or coordinates and must remain distinct.
